import json, time, hashlib
from fractions import Fraction as F
import numpy as np
import mpmath as mp
from smatrix_bootstrap.primal_barrier import PrimalLogBarrier
start=time.monotonic()
p=json.load(open('results/primal_barrier_N10_support.json'));r=p['result']
seed=json.load(open(p['seed_path']));payload=json.load(open(p['input_path']))
model=PrimalLogBarrier.from_payload(payload,equality_rank=seed['equality_rank'],equality_rows=seed['equality_rows'],pivot_columns=seed['pivot_columns'],pivot_inverse=seed['pivot_inverse'])
x=list(map(F,r['x_rational']));ns,den=model.exact_slack(x);cert=model.certify_strict_slack(ns,den)
bar,gs,W,s=model.evaluate(ns,den,cert);mu=r['last_mu'];g=model.c_projected-mu*(model.B.T@gs)
with mp.workdps(80):
    m=mp.mpf(mu);z=list(map(mp.mpf,r['final_KKT']['z_decimal']));rd=list(map(mp.mpf,r['final_KKT']['dual_residual_decimal']))
    Q=model.eq.direction_basis;E=model.A[:model.zero].toarray()
    eqterm=[mp.fsum(mp.mpf(float(E[i,j]))*z[i] for i in range(model.zero)) for j in range(len(x))]
    rbase=[v-w for v,w in zip(rd,eqterm)]
    gmp=[mp.fsum(mp.mpf(float(Q[i,j]))*rbase[i] for i in range(len(x))) for j in range(Q.shape[1])]
    gmp_B=[mp.mpf(float(model.c_projected[j]))+mp.fsum(mp.mpf(float(model.B[i,j]))*z[i] for i in range(model.zero,len(z))) for j in range(Q.shape[1])]
    projected_residual=[mp.fsum(mp.mpf(float(Q[i,j]))*rd[i] for i in range(len(x))) for j in range(Q.shape[1])]
    eq_fit=[mp.fsum(mp.mpf(float(E[i,j]))*rd[j] for j in range(len(x))) for i in range(model.zero)]
    difference=[mp.mpf(float(a))-b for a,b in zip(g,gmp)]
    barrier_error=[mp.mpf(float(a))-b for a,b in zip(g,gmp_B)]
    gradient_info=dict(final_float_projected_gradient_inf=float(np.max(np.abs(g))),
      final_MP_projected_gradient_inf=str(max(map(abs,gmp))),
      float_vs_MP_gradient_absolute_inf=str(max(map(abs,difference))),
      float_barrier_derivative_vs_MP_using_same_B_inf=str(max(map(abs,barrier_error))),
      B_rounding_and_projection_difference_inf=str(max(abs(a-b) for a,b in zip(gmp_B,gmp))),
      equality_fit_E_times_rd_inf=str(max(map(abs,eq_fit))),
      equality_dual_inf=str(max(map(abs,z[:model.zero]))),
      Q_projection_of_eq_fit_difference_inf=str(max(abs(a-b) for a,b in zip(projected_residual,gmp))))
    indices=[int(np.argmax(np.abs(g))),0,123]
    curvature=[]
    smp=[mp.mpf(v)/den for v in ns]
    for j in indices:
        contributions=dict(nn=mp.mpf(0),soc=mp.mpf(0),psd=mp.mpf(0))
        for kind,offset,size in model.blocks:
            if kind=='nn':
                contributions[kind]+=mp.fsum((mp.mpf(float(model.B[i,j]))/smp[i])**2 for i in range(offset,offset+size))
            elif kind=='soc':
                sv=smp[offset:offset+size];dv=[mp.mpf(float(v)) for v in model.B[offset:offset+size,j]]
                det=sv[0]**2-mp.fsum(v*v for v in sv[1:]);mix=sv[0]*dv[0]-mp.fsum(a*b for a,b in zip(sv[1:],dv[1:]))
                contributions[kind]+=4*mix*mix/det**2-2*(dv[0]**2-mp.fsum(v*v for v in dv[1:]))/det
            else:
                S=mp.matrix(size);D=mp.matrix(size);k=offset
                for col in range(size):
                    for row in range(col+1):
                        scale=mp.mpf(1) if row==col else mp.sqrt(2)
                        S[row,col]=S[col,row]=smp[k]/scale
                        D[row,col]=D[col,row]=mp.mpf(float(model.B[k,j]))/scale;k+=1
                V=(S**-1)*D
                contributions[kind]+=mp.fsum(V[a,b]*V[b,a] for a in range(size) for b in range(size))
        true=sum(contributions.values());floatcurv=float(W[:,j]@W[:,j])
        curvature.append(dict(direction_column=j,curvature_MP=str(true),curvature_float=floatcurv,
            relative_difference=str((mp.mpf(floatcurv)-true)/true),by_family={k:str(v) for k,v in contributions.items()}))
    initial=list(map(F,seed['x_rational']));initial_obj=sum(F.from_float(float(c))*v for c,v in zip(model.c,initial))
    report=dict(archived_result='results/primal_barrier_N10_support.json',archived_sha256=hashlib.sha256(open('results/primal_barrier_N10_support.json','rb').read()).hexdigest(),
      strict_terminal_cones_reverified=cert['strict'],mu=mu,gradient=gradient_info,hessian_directional_checks=curvature,
      initial_scaled_objective=str(initial_obj),initial_physical_f11=-float(initial_obj)/16,
      terminal_scaled_objective=r['final_KKT']['objective'],terminal_physical_f11=r['physical_objective_reporting']['estimated_f11'],
      no_Newton_step_computed=True,no_optimization_run=True,elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic()-start)
print(json.dumps(report,indent=2))
open('results/primal_barrier_N10_support.derivative_audit.json','w').write(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
